svg.title: Lord of Dominion: Two of Wands · Mars in Aries · Chokmah (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Mars above the painting and Aries below, as Book T places them: "On two small wands above and below, with flames of five issuing therefrom, are the symbols of Mars and Aries for the Decan." The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/grammars/1793198836172-069z5qdzyalk.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
